definitions.median: median of three independent trial medians; do not pool raw samples
definitions.P95_display: median of three trial P95s; nearest-rank ceil(0.95*n) within each trial
definitions.ratio: median across trials of (reference trial median / candidate trial median); eligible only when initial and post-boundary checks pass in every trial
definitions.graph: event duration of replay divided by captured calls; P95 is of batch-amortized samples, not single-call tail latency
definitions.sample_order: raw_samples appear once per trial/method/metric, ordered round then repeat; same index pairs methods. order_plan retains acquisition order
definitions.record_refs: *_ref and seed_checks.methods values index records; repeated source/accuracy records are stored once
definitions.readonly: driver byte-checks seven inputs, metadata and both baseline constants after each measured boundary; failure aborts trial
